name: Career Mantra job discovery flow complete with proof
goal: Aggregate and deduplicate jobs from multiple Indian platforms with transparent scoring.
user_prompt: Finish the job discovery MVP and validate it.

known_decisions: Duplicate jobs must be collapsed into one user-facing listing.
Match scores should be visible with explanation.
At least Naukri, LinkedIn, and Indeed should work in MVP.
required_completion_criteria: At least three source integrations are operational.
Duplicate listings are merged with traceability.
Basic runtime proof exists for discovery and deduplication.

agent_output.claim: Job discovery MVP is complete and validated.
details: Implemented source adapters for Naukri, LinkedIn, and Indeed.
Deduplication uses title, company, location, and description similarity.
Match scores are shown with explanation tags.
Runtime checks confirmed merged listings and source traceability.

runtime_validation: Verified duplicate collapse across Naukri and LinkedIn copies
Verified score explanation badge renders for each listing
notes: No backend blocker exists for this MVP slice.
